slices.focus: Kelli builds a formal shared defect log that shifts vendor conversations from vague promises to evidence-based accountability.
slices.summary: Kelli compiles three months of denial examples into a shared defect log grouped by payer, clinic, and error source, with plain-English descriptions and remit numbers. Monica forces weekly vendor issue calls using the log as the source of truth, changing the tone from vague investigation to claim-level accountability. Kelli plans a one-page intake rules sheet and adds owner-plus-vendor-action-date fields.
